# Search quality — 30 days to 2026-09-18

*2026-08-19 05:33:45 to 2026-09-18 05:33:45*

Search handled 300 searches this period at a health score of 66.3/100. There is no earlier period in the loaded data, so this digest stands alone rather than reporting a trend. 26 queries are failing badly enough to need attention, and 11 of the flagged terms are products the catalogue stocks but search did not surface.

## What changed

No earlier period exists in the loaded log, so there is nothing to compare against yet. The table appears from the second digest onwards.

## Searches that came back empty

8.0% of searches returned nothing at all.

| Query | Searches | Empty | Catalogue | Cause |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | --- |
| “kombucha” | 4 | 4 | not stocked | assortment gap |
| “quinoa” | 4 | 4 | not stocked | assortment gap |
| “wasabi” | 4 | 4 | not stocked | assortment gap |
| “truffle” | 3 | 3 | not stocked | assortment gap |
| “زعفران” | 3 | 3 | not stocked | assortment gap |
| “كافيار” | 3 | 3 | not stocked | assortment gap |
| “كينوا” | 3 | 3 | not stocked | assortment gap |

## What needs attention

**1. “دجاج”** **(new this period)** — 16 searches, severity 0.36
- Only 4.6 of 5 result slots filled on average.
- Ranking is unstable: 100% of repeat searches returned a different set of products.
- 100% of these searches were immediately retried or reworded.

**2. “حليب”** **(new this period)** — 16 searches, severity 0.35
- Only 4.9 of 5 result slots filled on average.
- Ranking is unstable: 87% of repeat searches returned a different set of products.
- 75% of these searches were immediately retried or reworded.
- 12% of these searches were re-fired within two seconds with identical results, which looks automated rather than human; those are excluded from the engagement figures.

**3. “juice”** **(new this period)** — 13 searches, severity 0.41
- Only 3.2 of 5 result slots filled on average.
- Ranking is unstable: 50% of repeat searches returned a different set of products.
- 89% of these searches were immediately retried or reworded.
- 8% of these searches were re-fired within two seconds with identical results, which looks automated rather than human; those are excluded from the engagement figures.

**4. “عصير”** **(new this period)** — 13 searches, severity 0.38
- Only 3.3 of 5 result slots filled on average.
- Ranking is unstable: 58% of repeat searches returned a different set of products.
- 78% of these searches were immediately retried or reworded.

**5. “شاي”** **(new this period)** — 11 searches, severity 0.44
- Only 3.4 of 5 result slots filled on average.
- Ranking is unstable: 50% of repeat searches returned a different set of products.
- 100% of these searches were immediately retried or reworded.
- 9% of these searches were re-fired within two seconds with identical results, which looks automated rather than human; those are excluded from the engagement figures.

## Awaiting review

34 proposals are pending (8 misspelling, 1 partial query, 25 synonym). Strongest first:

- `chicken` → `دجاج` (synonym, confidence 0.84)
- `milk` → `حليب` (synonym, confidence 0.84)
- `فاراوله` → `فراوله` (misspelling, confidence 0.80)
- `فراولت` → `فراوله` (misspelling, confidence 0.80)
- `chiken` → `chicken` (misspelling, confidence 0.78)

None of these are applied until a reviewer approves and exports them.

## How to read these numbers

- No click or order data exists in this dataset, so engagement is inferred from whether shoppers searched again. Searches that ended a session are excluded rather than assumed successful.
- 3% of searches were re-fired within two seconds with identical results and look automated rather than human; they are excluded from the engagement figures.
